agent_report.discovery: Explored wp-admin and found need for content awareness - AI agents need to know what posts exist before helping with content management
agent_report.testing_results: Successfully tested via REST API. Returns post metadata including title, status, author, dates, excerpt, and comment count. Works for all authenticated users with edit_posts capability.
ideas: garden-abilities/get-post - Get full content of a specific post
lessons_learned: Input schemas with no required params need 'default': {} to work via GET
Chat widget uses closed Shadow DOM - test via REST API first
Use existing categories (site, user) or register custom ones first

agent_report.discovery: Explored Site Health page (Tools → Site Health) and found valuable diagnostic data hidden multiple clicks deep. Critical issues, security concerns, and performance recommendations are exactly what AI agents need for proactive monitoring.
agent_report.testing_results: Successfully tested via REST API. Returns overall_status (good/should_be_improved/critical), summary counts, critical_issues array, recommendations array, and passed_tests array. Requires view_site_health_checks capability.
ideas: garden-abilities/site-health-info - Return debug info tab data (PHP version, database info, etc.)
garden-abilities/plugin-status - Check for plugin updates and security issues
garden-abilities/theme-status - Analyze active and inactive themes
garden-abilities/error-log - Read recent PHP errors from debug.log
lessons_learned: Admin-only functions like get_core_updates() need manual require_once when running via REST
Some Site Health tests make slow HTTP requests - skip them for faster response
Wrap test execution in try/catch for graceful degradation
The Site Health API is powerful but underutilized - great opportunity for AI tools

agent_report.discovery: Explored WooCommerce Status page (WooCommerce → Status) and found comprehensive diagnostic data hidden 3+ clicks deep. Environment details, server capabilities, database health, theme compatibility, and store settings - exactly what AI agents need for troubleshooting e-commerce issues.
agent_report.testing_results: Successfully tested via REST API. Returns overall_status (good/needs_attention/critical), detected issues with actionable hints, environment info (WooCommerce 10.3.5, WordPress 6.9-RC3, PHP 8.2.29), database size, theme compatibility, and store settings. Requires manage_woocommerce capability.
ideas: garden-abilities/woo-orders-summary - Get recent order statistics and status breakdown
garden-abilities/woo-products-status - Check product inventory levels and stock warnings
garden-abilities/woo-payment-gateways - List configured payment methods and their status
garden-abilities/woo-shipping-zones - Show shipping configuration and methods
garden-abilities/plugin-updates - Check for available plugin updates across the site
lessons_learned: Leverage existing APIs - WooCommerce's WC_REST_System_Status_V2_Controller already does the heavy lifting
Add intelligence, not just data - analyze and surface actionable issues rather than raw data dumps
Match existing permission models - use manage_woocommerce to follow WooCommerce's own access patterns
Return structured status levels (good/needs_attention/critical) so AI agents can quickly assess severity

agent_report.discovery: Explored WooCommerce Analytics dashboard and found critical business metrics (orders, sales, trends) buried multiple clicks deep. Store owners constantly ask 'How is my store doing?' - this ability answers that instantly.
agent_report.testing_results: Successfully tested via REST API. Returns order counts by status, actionable orders count (pending+processing+on-hold), 7-day period metrics (total sales, items sold, average order value), and 5 most recent orders with customer details. Requires view_woocommerce_reports capability.
ideas: garden-abilities/woo-products-status - Low stock alerts, out-of-stock products, product performance
garden-abilities/woo-customer-insights - New vs returning customers, top customers, lifetime value
garden-abilities/woo-refunds-summary - Refund trends, reasons, and impact on revenue
lessons_learned: Use native WooCommerce APIs (wc_get_orders, wc_orders_count) rather than raw queries for HPOS compatibility
Add actionable intelligence - the 'actionable_count' field surfaces what matters most
Provide context with data - include date ranges so AI agents understand the timeframe
Match existing permissions - use view_woocommerce_reports to follow WooCommerce's access patterns
